facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; no exchange controls, though currency movements are monitored.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Not confirmed yet; with no exchange controls, foreign-currency accounts are likely allowed.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Citizens and PRs register a business name with ROCBN online via OCP.
facts.L2_tax_id: No TIN for individuals; only companies are taxed.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: No personal income tax, including on freelance earnings.
facts.L4_vat_gst: No VAT, GST or sales tax.
facts.L5_data_protection: Personal Data Protection Order 2025, mostly in force since January 2026.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act; online cancellation rights not confirmed.
facts.L7_incentives: No personal income tax is the main advantage.

watch_out.text: Foreigners without PR can't register a sole proprietorship.
